panels.title: DAU
panels.description: Number of daily active users (DAU) - users with activity in last 24h.

panels.title: WAU
panels.description: Number of weekly active users (WAU) - users with activity in last 7 days.

panels.title: New Registrations (24h)
panels.description: User registrations in last 24 hours from database.

panels.title: Login Rate
panels.description: User login rate (logins/hour) — includes password + OAuth Engagement tracking.

panels.title: Logins by Provider
panels.description: Total user login attempts and successes.

panels.title: Return Rate by Window
panels.description: Users returning to app after first conversation.

panels.title: Daily Conversations/User
panels.description: Number of conversations per user per day. Shown: p50 percentile.

panels.title: Conversations Created
panels.description: Conversation creation rate Feature adoption.

panels.title: Conversations Reactivated
panels.description: Total soft-deleted conversations reactivated.

panels.title: Conversation Resets
panels.description: Total conversation resets by users. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Messages by Role
panels.description: Total messages archived to conversation_messages table.

panels.title: Conversation Length Distribution
panels.description: Number of messages in completed conversations (distribution).

panels.title: Conversation Turns by Agent
panels.description: Number of user-agent turns per conversation.

panels.title: Conversation Repository Queries
panels.description: Query count by implementation version (legacy vs optimized).

panels.title: Message Query Duration
panels.description: Query duration for message retrieval with token summaries. Shown: p95 percentile.

panels.title: Abandonment Rate by Agent
panels.description: PHASE 3.2 - BUSINESS METRICS (Part 2 - P1 High Priority) These recording rules pre-aggregate business metrics instrumented in Part 2 (Steps 2.1-2.4) for efficient dashboard queries and alerting.

panels.title: Abandonment by Reason
panels.description: Total conversations abandoned (user stopped responding).

panels.title: Avg Messages at Abandonment
panels.description: Average message count at abandonment by reason (5m window) Understand when users abandon (early vs late in conversation) Early abandonment (<3 messages) indicates onboarding issues.

panels.title: P95 Messages at Abandonment
panels.description: P95 message count at abandonment (5m window) Detect outlier abandonment patterns.

panels.title: Conversation Cost by Agent
panels.description: Average tokens consumed per conversation by agent (1h window) Cost attribution per agent type High token usage may indicate inefficient prompts.

panels.title: Agent Success Rate
panels.description: Agent success rate (rolling 1h) SLO target = 95% success rate.

panels.title: Graph Exceptions Rate (by node/type)
panels.description: Total exceptions in graph execution. Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Router High-Confidence Rate (proxy for accuracy)
panels.description: Total router decisions.

panels.title: Connector Activation Rate
panels.description: Percentage of users with at least one active connector (0-1).

panels.title: Agent Latency P95 (per intention)
panels.description: AGENT LATENCY SLOs Agent execution P95 latency (by agent type) SLO target = p95 < 3000ms for agents.

panels.title: Cost per Successful Conversation
panels.description: Cost per successful conversation (only conversations that achieved goal). Shown: p50 percentile.

panels.title: Attachments Uploaded (24h)
panels.description: Total file attachments uploaded.

panels.title: Attachment Types
panels.description: Total file attachments uploaded.

panels.title: Upload Rate
panels.description: Attachment upload success rate (5m rolling window) Track upload reliability.

panels.title: Upload Size Distribution
panels.description: Size of uploaded attachments in bytes. Shown: p50/p95 percentile.

panels.title: Active Attachments
panels.description: Current number of active (non-expired) attachments.

panels.title: Upload Errors
panels.description: Attachment upload error rate (5m rolling window) Detect upload issues.

panels.title: Upload duration p95 (by content_type)
panels.description: Attachment upload pipeline duration (1h window — uploads are sparse).

panels.title: Attachment cleanup deletions (by reason)
panels.description: Attachments deleted by the cleanup job, by reason (TTL, orphan...). Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Registrations (by provider / status)
panels.description: Password-based user registrations by provider and status (OAuth signups are tracked separately by oauth_user_creation_total). Empty panel = zero events in the window (healthy).

panels.title: Reset: keys deleted by family (24h)
panels.description: Redis keys a conversation reset deleted, per declared family (conversation and user-cache scopes). A learning family (recurrence, gmail_history_anchor, adaptive, briefing:v2:lastgood) must NEVER appear here.

panels.title: Reset: keys kept by scope / undeclared families (24h)
panels.description: What a reset matched but kept: learning and runtime scopes are expected; an 'undeclared' family is a key the registry can neither purge nor protect knowingly — declare it in infrastructure/cache/key_families.py.
